headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 30, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Junior Perez leading the charge. Perez hit a home run, drove in three runs, and had a strong outing in the field. In other action, the Texas Rangers took down the Cleveland Guardians 4-2, with Jacob deGrom pitching 7.0 innings and striking out 9 batters. The Detroit Tigers also secured a convincing 9-3 victory over the New York Yankees.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Kris Bubic, who was placed on the 60-day injured list by the Kansas City Royals due to left elbow soreness. The Royals also placed Connor Seabold on the 15-day injured list with a right lat strain. The Texas Rangers placed Corey Seager on the 10-day injured list with lower back inflammation, while the Detroit Tigers placed Will Vest on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 28, 2026, with right posterior elbow inflammation.

The MLB trade market was active, with several notable moves. The Chicago White Sox acquired Ben Hartl from the Texas Rangers, while the Athletics traded 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen. The Seattle Mariners acquired 1B Buddy Kennedy from the San Francisco Giants for cash, and the Athletics traded RHP Hayden Juenger to the Athletics for C Owen Carapellotti. The Chicago Cubs acquired LHP David Peterson from the New York Mets for 3B Cole Mathis.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Orioles 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, led by Junior Perez's impressive performance at the plate. Perez hit a home run, drove in three runs, and had a strong outing in the field.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Guardians in Thrilling 4-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a hard-fought win against the Cleveland Guardians, with Jacob deGrom leading the charge on the mound. DeGrom pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Suffer Shutout Loss to Phillies**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates fell to an 8-0 defeat at the hands of the Philadelphia Phillies. Trea Turner led the Phillies' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a convincing 9-3 victory over the New York Yankees, behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Riley Greene led the Tigers' offense with a pair of home runs and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Shut Down White Sox in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 6-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Noah Schultz leading the way for the Orioles' pitching staff. Impact hitters for the Orioles included Sam Antonacci and Tyler O'Neill, while Leody Taveras and Blaze Alexander had notable performances for the White Sox.

top_news.title: **Rangers Fall to Guardians in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 9-4 victory over the Texas Rangers, handing the Rangers their latest defeat. MacKenzie Gore stood out for the Guardians, while Ezequiel Duran and Elias Díaz contributed to the Rangers' offense.

top_news.title: **Royals Place Kris Bubic on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals left-handed pitcher Kris Bubic has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to left elbow soreness.

top_news.title: **White Sox Acquire Ben Hartl in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have bolstered their roster with the addition of catcher Ben Hartl, who was traded to the team. The move comes as part of a trade with the Texas Rangers.
